glosses: A form of land taxation that replaced Danegeld in twelfth-century England.
vi_hint: Loại thuế ruộng đất thay cho Danegeld ở Anh từ thế kỉ XII.

glosses: Synonym of corporate tax.
vi_hint: Thuế doanh nghiệp; Thuế Công ty.

glosses: An official building, in a port, where customs are collected and shipping is cleared for entry and exit
A tax raised originally to pay tribute or protection money to the Viking raiders in the 10th and 11th centuries to save a land from being ravaged, and later continued as a land tax.
Any kind of tribute.
A bilateral treaty between two countries to resolve issues related to double taxation.
The levying of tax by two or more jurisdictions on the same income.
Liable or subject to excise.
Able to be excised.
Any of various taxes levied on the production or sale of certain goods, especially on luxuries, tobacco, alcohol etc.
A tax, usually income tax, whose percentage rate or currency value remains constant, regardless of the amount to which the tax is applied.
A tax very similar to a value added tax, levied, for example, in Australia, Canada, New Zealand, and Singapore.
Income generated before deducting expenses, taxes, insurance, etc.
In United States tax law, income that is subject to taxation under the Internal Revenue Code (see Internal Revenue Code 61).
One of various compounds of germanium, antimony, and tellurium used as a phase change material, including GeSbTe.
A tax levied on earned and unearned income, net of allowed deductions.
A tax based on the value of the property of a deceased person, and charged on the beneficiaries of the estate.
A per capita tax levied on a section of an Islamic state's non-Muslim citizens, who meet certain criteria.
Gross profit minus operating expenses and taxes.
Income after tax.
vi_hint: Thu nhập ròng là khoản thu nhập sau khi đã khấu trừ các khoản thuế và đầu tư khác.

glosses: Acorns and beech mast used as forage for pigs.
Feeding of pigs on acorns and beech mast in the woods.
The right to feed pigs in this manner.
A tax formerly paid for the privilege of feeding swine in the woods.
vi_hint: Quyền thả lợn vào rừng kiếm ăn.
Tiền thuế thả lợn vào rừng kiếm ăn.
Quả làm thức ăn cho lợn (quả sến, quả dẻ... ).

glosses: A tax determined as a uniform, fixed amount per individual.
A tax that must be paid in order to vote.
a tax whose percentage increases as a person's wealth increases.
A tax, usually ad valorem, charged on the value of a property.
